basic_info.description: THIS IS THE ONE. Bright, open, and spacious 3+ bedroom co-op in an iconic building. Perfectly blending traditional detailing with a modern, open layout, this home offers pristine interiors, abundant light, and breathtaking views.    Step into the grand lobby and take the elevator to your own private landing. Inside, you'll find bright and inviting living and dining rooms with a fireplace and sweeping views of the Bay. The large, open kitchen features ample counter space and room for a breakfast table.    With three oversized bedrooms, all with ensuite bathrooms, and an additional flexible room for an office, guest space, or entertainment, this home has it all.    If you're looking for bright, stunning spaces, your search ends here.
